note: Preview gallery of the ecolog tree window («Науковий термінал») for ui_gallery index=preview/ecolog.json. The window's root is the whole host, the 1600x900 stage centred in it. Fixtures only set texts and colours and show the skin's hidden parts (capitals with the Latin I, as OZL_Text.Upper writes them for the vanilla Metron): ecolog-window -- the header with its tracked word pictures (the layout's Ukrainian ones; the live window loads the player's language) and three pool instruments (the live window shares the row's width out by the number of lines; here they keep the four-line width); ecolog-card -- the protocol of a node being researched (bold clock, 20 segments); ecolog-node -- a selected node being researched (its underline keeps the layout's width; the live window fits it to the name). What the skin lays out at run time (tier labels, the price under a node, the opens chips' frames, the close key, the underline) needs the live menu: world_exec oz_research treeui. A fixture travels to the bridge as one JSON string of at most ~1000 bytes on the wire.
